meta.title: Reduce LAN game timeout from 15 to 5 seconds for faster testing
meta.body_summary: Reduce LAN game server shutdown timeout from 15s to 5s; later evolved into proper socket reuse (SO_REUSEADDR) with local-server only scope per maintainer feedback.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot shifted from timeout band-aid to socket reuse per maintainer direction; merged after iterative commits but post-merge test compilation issue noted.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 431 changed lines across 7 files, this is a medium-scale change, combining a simple timeout reduction with substantial socket reuse logic and tests. The merge outcome fits a successful iterative fix driven by maintainer feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer kellyelton argued that timeout duration wasn't the root issue and requested a proper port reuse solution; later insisted on local_server flag to avoid affecting online servers.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce waiting time from 15s to 5s for LAN games and later enable immediate port reuse to avoid connection errors.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The task required low-level socket programming (SO_REUSEADDR, fallback ports) and careful scoping to avoid breaking online server behavior. Copilot iterated across multiple commits following maintainer direction, eventually producing a merged solution despite post-merge test issues.

detection_detail.code_reading: kellyelton reviewed the initial timeout change and pushed for a root-cause fix; also demanded local_server flag to preserve online server backward compatibility.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests validate behavior but no performance benchmarks or profiler data; manual testing likely but not recorded.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After merge, maintainer noted that unit tests in the PR did not compile due to missing namespace references. No follow-up commit observed in timeline.

core_change_summary.description: Initial commit reduced LAN game timeout in PlayerCollection.cs from 15s to 5s. Following maintainer feedback, subsequent commits implemented proper socket reuse with SO_REUSEADDR and fallback port selection in Server.cs, gated behind a local_server parameter. Also added game status reset logic on all players disconnect and corresponding unit tests, though some tests had compilation issues.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files were added and removed across commits; final test coverage includes port reuse tests and game status reset tests, but a compilation error was reported post-merge.
change_trajectory: Initial commit reduced LAN timeout to 5s and added PlayerCollectionTimeoutTests.
Maintainer requested different approach; Copilot removed old tests and implemented game status reset on disconnect.
Maintainer then requested root-cause fix; Copilot added socket reuse logic in Server.cs with new test file.
Maintainer asked for local_server flag; Copilot added optional parameter and updated tests.
PR merged with one APPROVED review, but post-merge comment indicated test files had namespace errors preventing compilation.
